name: low-chair-advantages
of: A mechanism by which a low chair confers something the chair above cannot have, named with the carrier that keeps it (the beliefs of those above, the record kept about one, what one holds, the work itself, or a second order held on purpose), the moment on rising at which it is lost, and what keeping it deliberately would cost.
items: Fool's license: words that arrive pre-discounted cannot be a challenge, so a truth passes from the fool that from a peer would have to be answered, as Lear's fool, or the junior on a trading desk who says the position is insane, is laughed at, and watches the desk quietly re-hedge; carried in the discount others apply, it ends the first time anyone acts on the words in the open, and a riser keeps it only by staying unheard; not credited sincerity, which works by being relied on, but a truth that works by needing no reply.

Word without a move: talk from someone who can gain nothing by it is read as information rather than positioning, so the junior's memo is read as analysis and the chief's as a move, as the Rule of Benedict sends the abbot to hear the youngest, or the shop assistant who says she would not buy it; carried in others' estimate of your stake, it is lost at the first stake, real or suspected; not the fool's license, which works by needing no reply, but credit, which works by being relied on.

Dumb question's price: the cost of revealing that you do not know is proportional to what your chair says you should know, so the obvious question that topples a ten-year ritual can be asked cheaply only from the bottom, as the new hire's 'why do we do this?'; lost on the day you are supposed to know, and it returns at the summit, where a Nobel makes Feynman's dumb question a display of security rather than a gap, so it is dearest in the middle; not fresh eyes, which a new chief also has and which do not lower the price of confessing.

Servant's eye: those above behave as if unobserved before a chair they do not count as an audience, so the low chair sees the natural behaviour no colleague sees, as the night nurse knows which surgeon is dangerous and the cleaner knows who is about to be fired; carried by the contempt of the watched, not by any hiding, it is lost the day they begin to perform for you, which is the day of promotion into the audience; the summit can rent it by disguise, as Haroun al-Rashid walked the market, and the rental expires once disguise is known to be a practice; not a hide, which the watcher builds, but a blindness the watched build themselves.

Barber's chair: the powerful confide on purpose in whoever cannot use what they hear, so the barber, the driver, and the assistant are told what the deputy never is; carried in the confider's estimate of your incapacity, it is lost the moment you gain the capacity to act, as the assistant made a vice-president is told nothing thereafter, and it binds where the servant's eye did not, since what is told is owed secrecy and what was overheard is owed nothing; not unknowing exposure but knowing disclosure.

I just work here: acts and messages are attributed to the chair above, so the low chair can carry word between enemies or execute a decision without owning it, as the cook who passes between the factions or the clerk whose policy is not hers; carried in attribution, it is lost at the first signature, and its price is never being the author; its dark twin is the soldier's 'following orders', the same mechanism with the moral bill visible; not discounted speech but displaced authorship.

Costless no: a refusal says nothing about the asker when nobody expected a yes, so the low chair can ask fifty times where the high chair can afford to ask once, as the unknown freelancer's cold pitches or the intern asking the chief for coffee; the price of a probe is what its refusal reveals, and that is set by the chair; lost when your refusals become news, as the founder turned down in public; not the beggar's mouth, where the ask itself confesses need whether or not it is granted, since here the ask offers something and only the refusal could cost.

No file: nobody stores your failures or reversals, so they do not compound, as the open-mic comic who bombs two hundred nights or the unknown founder who pivots without a press cycle; carried in others' records rather than their beliefs, it is lost when the first success creates an audience that keeps you on file, and unlike a belief a file once opened does not close, so it is the one advantage no riser gets back except under a new name; not a costless refusal or an unguarded opening, but what happens to an event after it.

Beggar's mouth: asking for help costs status, so the chair with none asks for free while the high chair cannot ask without a fall, as the ruined financier who cannot say he is broke or the attending who cannot ask the nurse; carried in the status you hold, it is lost on the first rung, and the loss kills, since the newly high lose the ask before they lose the need; not a costless probe, which offers something, but a confession, paid whether or not it is answered.

Small change: a published rate is a signal and taking less damages it, so the whole lower market of work is reachable only by the chair whose rate is low, as the star who cannot play weddings or the former executive whom the shop calls overqualified; carried in the price attached to your name, it is lost at the first published high price, which is why a fall from a high chair goes past the floor rather than onto it; keepable by keeping the rate low, that is by refusing the income the rise offered; not favours and not help, but paid work.

Stone's blood: enforcement costs more than it recovers from someone with nothing seizable, so the low chair is unprosecuted for the small and uncollectible for the large, as the judgment-proof debtor or the sailor who jumps ship; carried in your holdings, it is lost at the first attachable asset, a wage or a deed, which is why the first pay rise of a rising person is also the day the creditors return; keepable only by holding nothing in your own name, which is a fraud or a vow; not the freedom to move but the immunity from being moved against.

No hostages: a move that would expose assets is open only to the one who has none, as the immigrant enters the trade the native cannot enter without losing face, or the challenger sells the thing that would cannibalise the incumbent; carried in what you hold, it is lost at the first acquisition worth defending, which is what winning is, and it can be kept only by vow, the monastic engineering of refusing to own; not the price of a refusal but the price of a move, and not immunity from being moved against.

Expendable scout: the low chair is sent first into the new or the dangerous because it can be lost, and so holds the frontier's knowledge before anyone above it, as the junior developer given the untried framework, the private issued the new weapon, the youngest son who emigrates; carried in your expendability, it is lost when you become too valuable to risk, and the knowledge is owed upward, unlike the free mover's; not a move chosen because nothing is held, but one assigned because you are cheap.

Ladder credit: where cash can settle, no obligation accrues, so the one who pays is owed nothing and the one who cannot pay builds credit in favours, the only credit line that survives a cash crash, as the susu among unbanked immigrants or the borrowed ladder that comes back as harvest help, and the exchange rate favours the poor, since gratitude is priced by sacrifice; carried in the known inability to pay, it is lost the day neighbours learn you can, when they stop owing and start billing; adds to obligation futures the exclusion, that cash sterilises the account; not the allies of many seats but the credit they enforce.

Many seats: a chair with many occupants and nothing beneath it has peers who are not rivals, so its honest feedback and mutual aid come free, where the high chair's peers compete and its subordinates cannot be friends, as the enlisted against the officers, the nurses' station, the cell block; lost the day you become the boss of your friends, and kept only by not competing for the next chair, since the same floor that lends is the floor that can hold you down; not the virtue of the occupants but their number.

Bosun's knowledge: the present state of the machine, which valve sticks, which workaround is load-bearing, which gauge lies, lives where the work is done and the chart above it is a model, as the bosun against the captain or the charge nurse against the attending; carried by the work itself, it decays at the rate the machine changes once you leave the floor, and it is the one advantage a riser keeps by continuing to take a shift, at the price of the hours the promotion was supposed to buy; not skill, which is portable and keeps, but the machine's current state, which is neither.

Second chair: a riser keeps the advantages that live in others' beliefs only by holding a genuinely low seat in a separate order, the white belt, the church basement, the amateur choir, where the discount, the harmlessness, and the cheap question can form again; not disguise, which fails once known, since the second chair really is low; lost the day the two orders touch and the dojo learns what you do on weekdays; the map's own proposal, and the one member that is a mechanism for keeping rather than for having.

source.register: Mechanistic and concrete: court fools, trading desks, night nurses, bosuns, barbers, judgment-proof debtors, susus, cell blocks, the Benedictine chapter, the dojo; drawn from trades, institutions, and the lives of people who must keep a floor under themselves.
source.mode: Clearly separated mixture: analytical mechanisms with observed illustrative cases for sixteen members, each simplified to one mechanism; the summit's recovery of two belief-borne members is an analytical reading with a speculative reach; Second chair is the map's own proposal and is marked so in its text.
source.via: practice-deep-ideonomy; two Fable fieldwork breaths; independent Fable editorial review
boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy or a partition; a real low chair usually holds several of these at once, and some hold none, since each depends on a carrier that a particular low chair may lack (the invisible nurse who is nonetheless fully on file).

The seriation is an itinerary by where the advantage is kept, not a ranking of value or of how often each occurs; the assignment of a member to a carrier is an interpretation (Costless no could be read as record-borne rather than belief-borne), and map edges are conditional authored claims.

The illustrative cases (Lear's fool, the Rule of Benedict's chapter, Haroun al-Rashid's market walks, the susu, Feynman's questions, the undercover chief) are simplified to one mechanism each and are not claims about the specific histories; the wolf pack was left out because its status science is contested.

The summit's recovery of an advantage (the disguised king, the laureate's dumb question) is claimed for two belief-borne members only, as an analytical reading with a speculative reach; no claim that any other member returns at the top, and Second chair is the map's own proposal rather than an observed institution.

Advantages that are transfers from an audience (sympathy for the underdog, charity, credit for beating a low bar) are outside, since the audience can withdraw them and the chair cannot operate them; the costs of the low chair (the scapegoat, the crab bucket, the scout's risk) appear only as the price of a member.

seriation.axis: Where the advantage is kept, and so what moment loses it: from advantages held entirely in the beliefs of those above (lost the instant they look again), through what others record about you (lost when the file opens, which it never un-does), through what you yourself hold, status, a price, seizable things (lost at the first acquisition, keepable by vow), to what the work itself holds (lost only on leaving the floor, keepable by keeping a shift), and finally to a second order held on purpose.
seriation.note: An authored itinerary, not a scale of value, rarity, or difficulty. Fool's license opens it because nothing carries it but the discount others apply, and one open act on the fool's words ends it; Second chair closes it because it is not kept in this order at all. The walk passes through four carriers, and each carrier has its own moment of loss and its own price of keeping: belief-borne members (Fool's license through Costless no) are lost on being seen and can be kept only by concealment or, for two of them, regained at the summit; No file alone is record-borne and is never regained; holdings-borne members (Beggar's mouth, Small change, Stone's blood, No hostages) are lost on acquiring and can be kept by refusing to own, which is what a vow of poverty engineers; work-borne members (Expendable scout, Ladder credit, Many seats, Bosun's knowledge) are lost on leaving the floor and are kept by staying on it. The hinge is Bosun's knowledge → Second chair: both keep an advantage by spending hours in a low place, but the bosun's floor belongs to the same order as the captain's chair, so the knowledge flows up and the belief-borne members do not return (the crew performs for a captain who stands a watch), whereas the second chair is a separate order, so the belief-borne members return and the work-borne ones do not transfer; the adjacency teaches that what a riser can keep depends on whether the low place is inside or outside the order they rose in. Inside the holdings block, Stone's blood → No hostages is the pair that shares one carrier and one loss moment, which is why the first rung is the most dangerous: the pay rise that returns the creditors is the acquisition that gives you something to defend.

exploration.first_question: By what mechanisms does a low chair confer something the chair above cannot have, and which of these can be kept on purpose by someone who rises, as against those available only to someone who genuinely has nothing?
exploration.changed_question: Where is each advantage kept, and is the moment of its loss the moment of being seen, of being recorded, of acquiring, or of leaving the floor? Breath one's members almost all lived in the beliefs of those above, and the answer to 'which can be kept' was a single one: only by not being seen. Sharpening Costless no against No file separated a belief held now from a record kept later, with different loss moments, and the carrier turned out to decide the keeping: what is kept in others' heads is kept by concealment or a second order, what is kept in one's holdings is kept by vow, what is kept in the work is kept by a shift.

priorities.item: Small change: a published rate is a signal and taking less damages it, so the whole lower market of work is reachable only by the chair whose rate is low, as the star who cannot play weddings or the former executive whom the shop calls overqualified; carried in the price attached to your name, it is lost at the first published high price, which is why a fall from a high chair goes past the floor rather than onto it; keepable by keeping the rate low, that is by refusing the income the rise offered; not favours and not help, but paid work.
priorities.why: It is the survival mechanism the map's first framing could not see at all, since it lives in a labour market's price signals rather than in anyone's regard, and it predicts something checkable: that a fall from a high chair overshoots the floor.
priorities.next_question: For one trade with a public rate ladder, session and touring musicians, list twenty players with their published rate and ask each whether they can be booked at the wedding rate under their own name; the prediction is that above some published rate no wedding booking exists at any price, and that the players who still reach that market do so under a second name or through a fixer who hides the rate.

priorities.item: Second chair: a riser keeps the advantages that live in others' beliefs only by holding a genuinely low seat in a separate order, the white belt, the church basement, the amateur choir, where the discount, the harmlessness, and the cheap question can form again; not disguise, which fails once known, since the second chair really is low; lost the day the two orders touch and the dojo learns what you do on weekdays; the map's own proposal, and the one member that is a mechanism for keeping rather than for having.
priorities.why: Low plausibility that it works as cleanly as written, high generative promise: it is the only member that answers the live question for the belief-borne class without deception, and it makes a testable claim about what happens when two status orders touch.
priorities.next_question: Find three risers who hold a known low seat in a separate order, a chief who is a white belt, a surgeon in an amateur orchestra, a bishop in a church-basement meeting, and record whether people in the second room say to them what nobody at work would; then find the day the room learned their weekday chair and ask whether the advantages died that day or survived because the low seat had been earned before the discovery.

gate.standard: declared type, close-neighbor discriminator, boundary case, and form inference

neighbors.left: Fool's license: words that arrive pre-discounted cannot be a challenge, so a truth passes from the fool that from a peer would have to be answered, as Lear's fool, or the junior on a trading desk who says the position is insane, is laughed at, and watches the desk quietly re-hedge; carried in the discount others apply, it ends the first time anyone acts on the words in the open, and a riser keeps it only by staying unheard; not credited sincerity, which works by being relied on, but a truth that works by needing no reply.
neighbors.right: Word without a move: talk from someone who can gain nothing by it is read as information rather than positioning, so the junior's memo is read as analysis and the chief's as a move, as the Rule of Benedict sends the abbot to hear the youngest, or the shop assistant who says she would not buy it; carried in others' estimate of your stake, it is lost at the first stake, real or suspected; not the fool's license, which works by needing no reply, but credit, which works by being relied on.
neighbors.separating_case: The junior on the desk who says the position is insane. If the desk laughs and re-hedges without saying so, the words worked by discount, nobody had to answer them, and the junior's chair is intact for next time: Fool's license. If the head trader says in the meeting that she is right, the words worked by credit, they were relied on because she had nothing to gain, and she is now a source: Word without a move. Same words, and the difference is whether anyone had to reply; and once relied on, the next thing she says is a move, so both licenses are gone together.

checks.boundary_case: Fresh eyes are out: the newcomer's not-yet-habituated perception is carried by novelty, not by the chair, since a new chief has fresh eyes too and pays full price for the obvious question the moment the honeymoon ends. Dumb question's price is in on exactly that contrast, since what the low chair confers is not the seeing but the cheapness of confessing.
checks.form_inference: The map shows an incompatibility the sequence conceals: Fool's license and Word without a move sit as neighbours on the itinerary, but the edge between them says the same words cannot be both unanswerable and relied on, so one open act on the fool's words converts the license into credit and ends it. It shows a dependency, Dumb question's price → Bosun's knowledge, where the cheap question and the knowledge that answers it must sit in different chairs, so a riser who keeps a shift regains one and not the other. It shows a passage between levels at Servant's eye → Barber's chair, overhearing becoming being told at the price of a bond, and a second passage at Beggar's mouth → Second chair, out of this order altogether. It shows a loop the line cannot express, Stone's blood → Ladder credit → Many seats → Stone's blood, in which being uncollectible forces favour-credit, favour-credit recruits the floor to enforce it, and the floor holds you at the floor, so a rise breaks the loop at every point at once. And it shows a fork at No hostages → Expendable scout, where the same frontier knowledge comes back with different debts depending on who paid the fare.
checks.target_preserved: Self-read only. Each member names a distinct carrier and a distinct moment of loss, and the strange ones (a credit line that cash sterilises, a rate that makes a fall overshoot the floor, an ask that dies before the need does, a truth that works by needing no reply, a seat held in another order on purpose) are kept as mechanisms rather than softened into advice about humility; the one member that answers the live question, Second chair, is marked as a proposal rather than promoted to an observed institution.
